Science fiction isn’t one genre—it’s a spectrum.

In this video, I break sci-fi down into seven distinct vibes, from grounded realism to full-on speculative madness. Whether you love hard sci-fi, space operas, cyberpunk, or philosophical science fiction, this framework explains why different sci-fi stories feel so different—and why fans argue about them constantly.

This is a follow-up to my Seven Levels of Fantasy video, but sci-fi plays by very different rules. Some sci-fi is about technology, some is about people, some is about politics, and some is about ideas so big they break your brain.

If you’ve ever wondered what kind of sci-fi you actually like—or why a book or movie didn’t work for you—this video will help you figure it out.
